items.title: Versant Stock Jumps 12% On Upbeat Outlook
items.summary: Shares in Versant Media rose sharply after the CNBC and MS Now owner raised its full-year revenue forecast, on track for their biggest one-day gain since spinning of from Comcast in January.  Versant said Thursday that it now expects revenue of between $6.2 billion and $6.45 billion, above analyst estimates of $6.41 billion.  The move came as Versant, which also owns platforms such as Rotten Tomatoes and Fandango, reported second-quarter results that beat expectations—through both revenue and profit fell in the period.
